https://www.dw.com/en/kosovo-pm-kurti-eg.text: Skip to content Skip to main menu Skip to more DW sites https://p.dw.com/p/5IV6p Opposition lawmaker Kadrijaj sparked an uproar in Kosovo's parliament after throwing an egg at caretaker PM Kurti Image: Valdrin Xhemaj/REUTERS Advertisement Kosovo's parliament was suspended on Saturday after an opposition lawmaker threw eggs at caretaker Prime Minister Albin Kurti . "Shame on you!" Time Kadrijaj of the conservative opposition Alliance for the Future of Kosovo (AAK) party shouted in parliament before hurling eggs at Kurti. In response, Kurti said that he was "happy to pay this price" if it was the cost of dialogue. Kurti's left-wing Vetevendosje (VV) party is known for its own parliamentary disruptions, with party representatives launching tear gas in the chamber in 2018 and also on multiple occasions in 2015. Kadrijaj's AAK has seven seats in parliament, making it the fourth-largest opposition group Image: Valdrin Xhemaj/REUTERS What is the political situation in Kosovo? The incident comes after days of negotiations as Kurti attempts to gain enough opposition support to elect a new president amid Kosovo's broader political crisis. The Balkan country has held three elections in over two years. Kurti achieved his parliamentary majority with ethnic minority MPs in a December election that followed an inconclusive vote in February 2025. His VV party's share of the vote fell from 51% to 43% in a snap election in June, but it maintained a parliamentary majority alongside ethnic minority allies. However, Kurti requires a two-thirds majority in parliament to elect a president. The current negotiations seem to have ground to another stalemate, with neither side having agreed to a candidate. A constitutional deadline to elect a speaker of parliament expired on Friday. Opposition lawmakers have threatened legal action over Kurti's request for more time to negotiate. Kosovo declared independence from Serbia in 2008 after the 1998-99 war, which ended with Serbia's withdrawal following a NATO bombing campaign. Kosovo has been recognized by over half of the world's countries , including the United States and most European Union countries. Belgrade considers Kosovo to be part of Serbia. https://jowhar.com/mcentee-visits-estoni.text: Home NEWS WORLD NEWS ARTICLE POLITICS SPORT Somali TV Quran karim NEWS ARTICLE WORLD NEWS POLITICS Sport QURAN Video Somali TV privacy-policy terms and conditions Home NEWS WORLD NEWS ARTICLE POLITICS SPORT Somali TV Quran karim NEWS WORLD NEWS Facebook X Telegram WhatsApp ReddIt Pinterest Digg European competitiveness will be discussed at a meeting Estonian Foreign Affairs Minister Margus Tsahkna Ireland’s new Minister for Foreign Affairs, Trade and Defence, Helen McEntee, is heading to Tallinn for a series of high-level talks as European leaders weigh fresh moves to bolster Ukraine and tighten pressure on Russia. In the Estonian capital, Minister McEntee will hold bilateral meetings with Estonian Foreign Affairs Minister Margus Tsahkna and a senior official from the country’s ministry of defence. The agenda is set to include EU support for Ukraine, further sanctions against Russia, and a range of defence and security issues. European competitiveness — a central priority for Ireland’s Presidency of the Council of the European Union — is also due to feature, alongside discussions on the next seven-year EU budget covering 2028-2034, during her meeting with Mr Tsahkna. “Ireland and Estonia are like-minded on the key issues facing Europe, above all on supporting Ukraine in its struggle against Russian aggression and on its journey towards membership of the European Union,” Minister McEntee said ahead of the visit. As part of the trip, she will sign a joint letter of intent with Estonia, committing both countries to work together to continue providing aid for education and health projects in Ukraine. Minister McEntee will also meet the permanent secretary of Estonia’s ministry of defence. Her visit comes days after political upheaval in Estonia, where a defence procurement scandal led to the resignation of defence minister Hanno Pevkur, who had held the post since 2022. Read the latest Ukraine stories A state-run audit found that Estonia’s defence ministry awarded a €70m contract to produce ammunition shells for Ukraine to a firm with no track record of manufacturing shells. Mr Pevkur, widely seen as a strong supporter of military assistance for Ukraine, said he had not read the contracts and told Estonia’s public news service ETV last week that he would step down as “a matter of political responsibility”. After Estonia, Minister McEntee will travel to Riga for talks with Latvian foreign minister Baiba Braže. Estonia and Latvia — both NATO members — have reported a number of Ukrainian drone incursions in recent months, incidents linked to Russian electronic signal jamming that can push drones off course. Last month, Italian fighter jets on a NATO patrol shot down a Ukrainian drone after it drifted into Latvian airspace from the borders with Russia and Belarus. NATO aircraft on an air patrol over Estonia took similar action in May. Beállítom Tűz ütött ki az Obersalzbergben található Sasfészek (Kehlsteinhaus) épületében. A dél-bajorországi rendőr-főkapitányság tájékoztatása szerint az első mentőegységek 21:52-kor érkeztek a helyszínre, ahol kiterjedt tüzet észleltek. A jelenlegi információk szerint a tűz keletkezésekor senki sem tartózkodott az étteremként üzemelő Sasfészekben, sérültekről nem érkezett jelentés. A tűz oka egyelőre nem ismert – írta Die Zeit . A Berchtesgadeni-Alpokban, 1834 méteres magasságban fekvő Sasfészek 1938-ban készült el, és a náci vezetés egykori, elzárt lakó- és kormányzati területének része volt, ahová a nyilvánosság nem léphetett be. A sziklaszirt tetején álló épület 1952 óta vendéglőként működik, és népszerű turisztikai célpont. A Münchner Merkur beszámolója szerint a tűzoltóegységek számára nehézséget jelent a Sasfészek megközelítése. A rendőrség tájékoztatása szerint a beavatkozó egységek jelenleg is intenzíven küzdenek a lángokkal. A hatóságok szerint egyelőre nem lehet megállapítani, mi vezetett a tűzesethez.
